verdict.overall: Since Sunday the biggest shift is APP, which rallied 71% to 389.88 and flipped from neutral to opposing options positioning while looking overbought at RSI 76 — a clear caution flag. Most other names (TSLA, PLTR, NVDA, AMAT, AVGO, SPY, QQQ) fell 3-15% with floor and ceiling levels sliding down in step, keeping their ranges intact even as trends stay down; GOOGL stands out as the steadiest, turning supportive with cheap options. Confidence in GOOGL's range looks to be rising, while confidence is falling for AMAT, NVDA and ZETA given earnings risk inside the next four weeks plus pricey options on ZETA.
